'''2010 US East Nationals Rick Zuchowski DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Rick Zuchowski]] at [[2010 US East Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Rick Zuchkowski
* '''Deck name:''' Pilkin's HD
* '''Username:''' Pilkin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
